title: Symmetric Models for Syndrome Decoding
summary: This paper introduces a new polynomial model for the exact variant of the Syndrome Decoding Problem (SDP) in the binary case. The model is based on elementary symmetric polynomials. We estimate the computational complexity of solving the corresponding polynomial system by establishing bounds on the degree of regularity and on the solving degree of the ideal associated to the model. The complexity estimate is lower than for previous polynomial models.
